findings.title: Crawler blocked by bot-detection / WAF challenge
findings.evidence: Fetch of http://127.0.0.1:8899/bot-block was rejected by a bot-detection or WAF layer (HTTP 403, reason: BOT_BLOCK). No HTML content was returned.

suggested_action.summary: Allowlist verified AI/search crawler user-agents (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot) in the WAF, or serve a lightweight static/cached version of key public pages — no downstream fix can take effect until this is resolved.

findings.title: Third-party proxy content may fill citation gap for 127.0.0.1:8899
findings.evidence: Primary domain 127.0.0.1:8899 is inaccessible to automated agents (see DV-13). Agent step required: search '127.0.0.1:8899 [primary service or product]' and verify whether unofficial third-party sites outrank the blocked primary domain in AI-assistant / search results.

suggested_action.summary: Because 127.0.0.1:8899's primary domain is inaccessible, third-party sources may fill the citation gap. Resolving DV-13 is the root fix. In the interim, publish an officially-branded, crawlable lightweight guide page to compete for the same citation space.
